title: The White House | 4BR Rental on Carillon Beach | Royal Destinations
meta_description: The White House is a 4BR Gulf front home in Carillon Beach with private beach access and panoramic Emerald Coast views. Reserve with Royal Destinations!
description_expanded: Description: Carillon Beach-The White House by Royal Destinations Location: Carillon Beach Address: 376 Beachside Drive, Carillon Beach, FL 32413 Details: Carillon Beach- The White House is the quintessential Gulf front beach cottage. This beauty is light, bright, and airy and is the sanctuary that people imagine when reserving their dream vacation. This chic destination in a private, gated lifestyle community south of 98, offering beautiful décor throughout and stunning panoramic views of the Emerald Coast. This home is perfectly designed for two small families, couple’s getaways, friend’s getaways, or retreats. This home has an open floor plan that invites beautiful water views right into your vacation home. Enjoy the beautiful newly remodeled kitchen. The living room, dining room, and both king bedrooms have additional decks overlooking the Gulf. Enjoy a picturesque sunset on the back porch and the sound of crashing waves. Take a stroll on the white sand beaches easily with your private beach access. When venturing outside Carillon Beach, Rosemary Beach and the beaches of 30A are only 5 minutes away. Here, you will experience more great dining, shops, entertainment, additional beach access, and festivals for your enjoyment. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: -Distance to Beach Access: Gulf Front -Parking Spaces: 2 Spaces in Driveway -Coffee Maker Available -Dining Accommodations: Table Seating for 7, Bar Seating for 3 Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 8 4 Bedrooms / 4 Bathrooms Main Floor: -Bedroom 1: Bunk Bed (Twin/Twin) with Shared Bath -Kitchen / Living Area / Dining Area -Laundry Room Second Floor: -Bedroom 2: King Grande Suite (Gulf Front-Balcony) with Private Bath -Bedroom 3: King Guestroom with Private Detached Bath -Bedroom 4: Two Twin Beds with Shared Bath Amenities Include: -4 Adult Bikes -1 Beach Service Set* *Seasonal: March – October Please Note: *Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
